page.title: Investor Relations
page.description: Investor Relations holds everything Moonlight Resources has disclosed to the market and to shareholders. ASX Announcements is the authoritative record of market disclosures under the ASX Listing Rules, Investor Presentations covers materials prepared for investors and analysts (roadshows, briefings), and Annual Reports holds the annual and half-year reporting suite. Anything published here should already be public — this is a mirror of disclosed information, not a place for material that hasn't cleared continuous disclosure obligations.
